summary: This bill amends the Child Care and Development Block Grant Act of 1990 to require states to include in their plans a description of their internal controls, processes for investigating and recovering fraudulent payments, procedures for imposing sanctions, and methods for documenting and verifying eligibility, including how they use data across agencies to oversee child care providers.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Child Care and Development Block Grant Act to require states to include descriptions of their internal controls, fraud investigation processes, and eligibility verification procedures in their plans. This aims to reduce fraudulent payments within a social safety net program, thereby reducing welfare spending.
